visual_overrides.core_identity: A rooted predatory fungus that resembles a large mushroom while several long whip-like tendrils lash from its body.
visual_overrides.silhouette: Thick mushroom stalk and cap with multiple long narrow tendrils extending in sweeping curves.
visual_overrides.body_shape: Rooted fungal stalk with cap and four or more flexible tendrils emerging around the upper stalk.
visual_overrides.surface: Simple cap and stalk with sparse spots; tendrils smooth and uncluttered.
must_keep: clear contrast between mushroom body and tendrils
